experiment: Two LoRA optimizer steps; three teacher-forced probes of 24 tokens each; 10,939,392 logits compared before and after merging.

fp32_master_merge.selection_reason: FP32 matrix reassociation produced a maximum error of 3.77e-5. A 1e-4 absolute floor covers this measured error near zero with margin. BF16 tolerance was not relaxed. Saved FP32 exports are reloaded and checked against the unmerged FP32 model.

precision_contract: Training and generation retain their configured FP32 or BF16 precision. Export merges, saves and verifies FP32 master weights; artifact parity metadata records export, training and inference dtypes separately.
limitation: Logit parity on fixed probes does not establish identical generated sequences for an unmerged BF16 adapter and a BF16-cast merged model. Offline/HTTP generation parity is checked separately against the same registered merged artifact.
